step6b.nat_localhost_reachable_finding: Claude's diff of the VM file before and after 6b shows exactly two changed lines: the audio line (intended) and the NAT line, <NAT/> -> <NAT localhost-reachable="true"/> (not intended; 6b changed only the audio option). The settings dumps agree: localhostReachable="0" right after creation, "1" after 6b. Mechanism: at creation VirtualBox 7.2.18 held the value off in memory (dump 0) but saved it as the empty default <NAT/>; when a fresh VBoxSVC re-read the file for 6b it took the empty default as on and, on the next save, wrote it out explicitly as true. So 'off' does not survive a restart of VirtualBox's service on this version. VirtualBox cannot be upgraded (owner freeze until Gate 20). The setting is isolation-relevant: with localhost reachable the guest could reach host services bound to 127.0.0.1 through 10.0.2.2.
step6b.mitigation_prepared: Start-FreshVm.ps1 via step7-start-vm.cmd, for every start of the VM: re-apply --nat-localhostreachable1 off, confirm localhostReachable=0 in the same VBoxSVC session, start the VM immediately, then record the value the running VM received from its own VBox.log (CFGM key LocalhostReachable = 0) into vm/start-<utc>.json; a non-zero value stops. Owner decision required before step 7: accept this per-start mitigation (recommended), or amend the specification (for example no network adapter at all), or stop.
